full_form: Hepatoblastoma, NOS -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: The most common primary liver malignancy under five, generally diagnosed under 3 years (López-Terrada 2025, p. 24). Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1. It may be registered without tissue on imaging with alpha-fetoprotein raised for age in a child aged 6 months to under 3 years, at basis of diagnosis 2 (Visser O, et al. Frontiers in Oncology 2023;13:1250549, Table 3).
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term, exact match to the generated morphology_entries[] name for 8970/3. REDCap's option string is 'Hepatoblastoma', which ICD-O-3.2 does not carry at any level (contract §2C); it is carried here as also_known_as so the REDCap label reaches the output block (ruling 6).

full_form: Embryonal hepatoma -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: An older name for hepatoblastoma. Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 synonym under 8970/3.

full_form: Hepatoblastoma, epithelioid -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: An epithelial hepatoblastoma. Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 related term under 8970/3.

full_form: Hepatoblastoma, mixed epithelial-mesenchymal -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: A hepatoblastoma with stromal elements such as osteoid, cartilage or spindle cells; with neural or melanin-containing elements it is called teratoid. Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 related term under 8970/3; teratoid hepatoblastoma per López-Terrada D, Stahlschmidt J, Pérez-Atayde AR. Virchows Archiv 2025;486(1):23-47, Table 1, p. 24, p. 25.

full_form: Pure fetal hepatoblastoma -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
also_known_as: Fetal hepatoblastoma with low mitotic activity
notes: Pure fetal pattern with very low mitotic activity, a diagnosis that applies only to a tumour resected up front (López-Terrada 2025, p. 24). Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: International Pediatric Liver Tumors Consensus subtype, López-Terrada D, Stahlschmidt J, Pérez-Atayde AR. Virchows Archiv 2025;486(1):23-47, Table 1, p. 24.

full_form: Crowded fetal hepatoblastoma -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: Fetal hepatoblastoma with higher mitotic activity. Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: Consensus subtype, López-Terrada D, Stahlschmidt J, Pérez-Atayde AR. Virchows Archiv 2025;486(1):23-47, Table 1, p. 24; p. 25.

full_form: Embryonal hepatoblastoma -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: The commonest hepatoblastoma epithelial pattern (López-Terrada 2025, p. 25). Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: Consensus subtype, López-Terrada D, Stahlschmidt J, Pérez-Atayde AR. Virchows Archiv 2025;486(1):23-47, Table 1, p. 24.

full_form: Cholangioblastic hepatoblastoma -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: A hepatoblastoma with biliary differentiation; it is not a cholangiocarcinoma. Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: Consensus subtype, López-Terrada D, Stahlschmidt J, Pérez-Atayde AR. Virchows Archiv 2025;486(1):23-47, Table 1, p. 24; p. 25.

full_form: Macrotrabecular hepatoblastoma -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: A hepatoblastoma with trabeculae more than five cells thick. The same pattern without nuclear beta-catenin is seen in paediatric hepatocellular carcinoma (López-Terrada 2025, p. 25), so code the report's own diagnosis. Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: Consensus subtype, López-Terrada D, Stahlschmidt J, Pérez-Atayde AR. Virchows Archiv 2025;486(1):23-47, Table 1, p. 24; p. 25.

full_form: HBL -> Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970)
notes: Abbreviation for hepatoblastoma. Every epithelial and mixed hepatoblastoma subtype is recorded as Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3); the subtype refines risk and does not change the code (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 24-25). A small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid component is decided by INI1.
coding_note: Abbreviation listed in the Group 7 Alias Build Instructions, entry 2.

full_form: Small cell undifferentiated hepatoblastoma -> 8970 or 8963, decided by INI1
notes: Not coded until INI1 is known. With INI1 lost it is a malignant rhabdoid tumour of the liver, Rhabdoid tumor, NOS (8963/3) — 22 of 23 such tumours had lost INI1 (Vokuhl C, et al. Genes, Chromosomes & Cancer 2016;55(12):925-931, p. 925). With INI1 retained it is Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3) (López-Terrada 2025, p. 25). Without an INI1 result it is recorded as Neoplasm, malignant (8000/3).
coding_note: Maps to both codes because INI1 decides between them (contract §4.3). needs_ihc_tree true: the INI1 step of g7_hepatic is the fork. maps_to_iccc3_subgroup_id is the INI1-retained subgroup; the INI1-lost case is VIIa2.

full_form: Rhabdoid tumor, NOS -> Rhabdoid tumor, NOS (8963)
notes: Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the liver: INI1 (SMARCB1) lost, or in about 5% INI1 kept and SMARCA4 lost (López-Terrada 2025, p. 37). A Group VII code at the liver only; at the kidney it is Group VI, in the central nervous system Group III, elsewhere Group IX.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8963/3. REDCap's option string 'Malignant rhabdoid tumor' is an ICD-O-3.2 synonym, carried as also_known_as (contract §2C).

alias: Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the liver
full_form: Malignant rhabdoid tumour of the liver -> Rhabdoid tumor, NOS (8963)
also_known_as: Extrarenal rhabdoid tumour of the liver
notes: Highly aggressive, about 5% of primary liver malignancies in infants; serum alpha-fetoprotein usually normal (López-Terrada 2025, p. 36). Defined by loss of INI1 (SMARCB1), or of SMARCA4 when INI1 is kept.
coding_note: Clinical descriptive term for 8963/3 at C22.

full_form: SMARCB1-deficient tumour of the liver -> Rhabdoid tumor, NOS (8963)
notes: INI1, SMARCB1, BAF47 and SNF5 name the same protein. Its loss in a small cell undifferentiated or rhabdoid liver tumour is malignant rhabdoid tumour (Vokuhl 2016, p. 925).
coding_note: INI1 vocabulary per contract §6.

full_form: Embryonal sarcoma -> Embryonal sarcoma (8991)
notes: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver: 9-15% of liver malignancies, peak age 6-10 years, alpha-fetoprotein usually normal (López-Terrada 2025, p. 35). Diagnosed on histology alone (p. 36). A Group VII code at the liver only; elsewhere 8991 is Group IX.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8991/3.

alias: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver
full_form: Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver -> Embryonal sarcoma (8991)
notes: Recorded as Embryonal sarcoma (8991/3). Diagnosed on histology alone; no immunohistochemical marker is diagnostic (López-Terrada 2025, p. 36). It can arise in a mesenchymal hamartoma.
coding_note: Consensus entity, López-Terrada D, Stahlschmidt J, Pérez-Atayde AR. Virchows Archiv 2025;486(1):23-47, Table 1, p. 24.

full_form: Calcifying nested stromal-epithelial tumor -> ICD-O-3.2 8975/1; ICCC-3 Group VII admits behaviour 3 only, so no Group VII code is emitted
notes: ICD-O-3.2 codes it 8975/1, uncertain whether benign or malignant, and has no behaviour-3 code for it. ICCC-3 Group VII admits behaviour 3 only, so no Group VII code is emitted; the case goes to the registrar. A rare low-grade liver tumour of children and young adults (López-Terrada 2025, p. 43).
coding_note: Behaviour exclusion, contract §3.1. maps_to_morphology_codes is empty, the Group 5 9514/9510-0 pattern: 8975 has no /3 entry in morphology_entries[]. REDCap's option string 'Calcifying nested epithelial stromal tumor' reverses the ICD-O-3.2 word order.

full_form: Hepatocellular carcinoma, NOS -> Hepatocellular carcinoma, NOS (8170)
notes: The second most common paediatric liver malignancy, about 20%, in older children and adolescents, often with an underlying liver disease (López-Terrada 2025, p. 27). Group VII at any site. Fibrolamellar carcinoma has its own code, 8171/3.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8170/3.

full_form: Hepatoma, NOS -> Hepatocellular carcinoma, NOS (8170)
notes: An older name for hepatocellular carcinoma. Recorded as Hepatocellular carcinoma, NOS (8170/3).
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 synonyms under 8170/3.

full_form: Hepatocellular carcinoma, fibrolamellar -> Hepatocellular carcinoma, fibrolamellar (8171)
notes: Fibrolamellar carcinoma has its own ICD-O-3.2 code, 8171/3; it is not recorded as 8170. It occurs mostly in adolescents and young adults, in a normal liver, and carries the DNAJB1::PRKACA fusion (López-Terrada 2025, p. 29). Not yet an option in the REDCap list.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8171/3, awaiting_layer1 (contract §2B, §3.2).

full_form: Hepatocellular carcinoma, scirrhous -> Hepatocellular carcinoma, scirrhous (8172)
notes: Not yet an option in the REDCap list. The closest mimic of fibrolamellar carcinoma, without the PRKACA rearrangement (Graham RP, et al. Modern Pathology 2015;28(6):822-829, p. 822).
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8172/3, awaiting_layer1.

full_form: Hepatocellular carcinoma, spindle cell variant -> Hepatocellular carcinoma, spindle cell variant (8173)
notes: Not yet an option in the REDCap list.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8173/3, awaiting_layer1.

full_form: Hepatocellular carcinoma, clear cell type -> Hepatocellular carcinoma, clear cell type (8174)
notes: Not yet an option in the REDCap list.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8174/3, awaiting_layer1.

full_form: Hepatocellular carcinoma, pleomorphic type -> Hepatocellular carcinoma, pleomorphic type (8175)
notes: Not yet an option in the REDCap list. A pleomorphic pattern in a hepatoblastoma is hepatoblastoma, not this code (López-Terrada 2025, p. 25).
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8175/3, awaiting_layer1.

full_form: Hepatocellular neoplasm NOS -> Neoplasm, malignant (8000)
notes: A provisional consensus category for tumours between hepatoblastoma and hepatocellular carcinoma, treated as high-risk hepatoblastoma (López-Terrada 2025, pp. 29-31). ICD-O-3.2 has no code for it. Recorded as Neoplasm, malignant (8000/3) at the liver until the registrar chooses between Hepatoblastoma, NOS (8970/3) and Hepatocellular carcinoma, NOS (8170/3).
coding_note: Contract §3.3, registrar item §11.3. The two candidate codes sit in different ICCC subgroups (VIIa1, VIIb); the tool does not choose.

full_form: Combined hepatocellular carcinoma and cholangiocarcinoma -> Combined hepatocellular carcinoma and cholangiocarcinoma (8180)
also_known_as: Mixed hepatocellular and bile duct carcinoma
notes: One tumour with intimately mixed hepatocellular and cholangiocellular differentiation, diagnosed on routine histology (Brunt E, et al. Hepatology 2018;68(1):113-126, p. 2). Two separate tumours are a collision, not this diagnosis.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term and synonyms under 8180/3.

full_form: Cholangiocarcinoma -> Cholangiocarcinoma (8160)
notes: Very rare in children. Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, large duct and small duct types and cholangiolocarcinoma included (Nagtegaal ID, et al. Histopathology 2020;76(2):182-188). A cholangioblastic hepatoblastoma is hepatoblastoma, not this code. Group VII at any site.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term and synonyms under 8160/3.

full_form: Perihilar cholangiocarcinoma -> Perihilar cholangiocarcinoma (8162)
notes: Recorded as Perihilar cholangiocarcinoma (8162/3). The REDCap option still reads 'Klatskin tumor', a name ICD-O-3.2 marks obsolete. Group VII at any site.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8162/3; 'Klatskin tumor' is an [obs] synonym (contract §3.6).

full_form: Bile duct cystadenocarcinoma -> Bile duct cystadenocarcinoma (8161)
notes: Recorded as Bile duct cystadenocarcinoma (8161/3), the code ICD-O-3.2 gives this term. The current classification calls the tumour a mucinous cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma, which ICD-O-3.2 codes 8470/3 (Salles-Silva E, et al. Seminars in Ultrasound, CT and MRI 2025;46(2):161-176, p. 165).
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8161/3. Registrar item §11.6.

alias: Mucinous cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma
full_form: Mucinous cystic neoplasm with an associated invasive carcinoma -> Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, NOS (8470)
notes: Recorded as Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, NOS (8470/3), the code ICD-O-3.2 gives this term. The hepatic form was formerly called biliary cystadenocarcinoma (Salles-Silva 2025, p. 165).
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 synonym under 8470/3.

full_form: Nuclear protein in testis (NUT)-associated carcinoma -> Nuclear protein in testis (NUT)-associated carcinoma (8023)
notes: Listed among the rare malignant liver tumours of childhood (López-Terrada 2025, Table 1, p. 24). Not yet an option in the REDCap list.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term and synonyms under 8023/3, awaiting_layer1.

full_form: Neuroendocrine tumor, NOS -> Neuroendocrine tumor, NOS (8240)
notes: At the liver this is a Group VII code. The REDCap option reads 'Carcinoid tumor, NOS', an ICD-O-3.2 synonym.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8240/3; REDCap drift, contract §2C.

full_form: Vipoma -> Vipoma (8155)
notes: The REDCap option reads 'Vipoma, malignant', a string ICD-O-3.2 does not carry; ICD-O-3.2 codes the tumour 8155/3 as 'Vipoma'.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8155/3; REDCap drift, contract §2C.

full_form: ACTH-producing tumor -> ACTH-producing tumor (8158)
notes: The REDCap option reads 'Endocrine tumor, functioning, NOS', which ICD-O-3.2 places at 8158/1, not at the behaviour-3 code this group holds.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8158/3; REDCap drift, contract §2C.

full_form: Urothelial carcinoma, sarcomatoid -> Urothelial carcinoma, sarcomatoid (8122)
notes: The REDCap option reads 'Transitional cell carcinoma, spindle cell', an ICD-O-3.2 synonym.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8122/3; REDCap drift, contract §2C.

full_form: Mucinous carcinoma, gastric type -> Mucinous carcinoma, gastric type (8482)
notes: The REDCap option reads 'Mucinous adenocarcinoma, endocervical type', a synonym ICD-O-3.2 marks obsolete.
coding_note: ICD-O-3.2 preferred term under 8482/3; the REDCap string is an [obs] synonym, contract §2C.

alias: Malignant liver tumour, type not stated
full_form: Malignant liver tumour, type not stated -> Neoplasm, malignant (8000)
notes: Recorded as Neoplasm, malignant (8000/3), unspecified malignant hepatic tumour, until a report names the type.
coding_note: Umbrella term, contract §6.

full_form: Hepatic carcinoma, lineage not stated -> Carcinoma, NOS (8010)
notes: A carcinoma of the liver whose report does not say hepatocellular or biliary. Recorded as Carcinoma, NOS (8010/3).
coding_note: Umbrella term for the VIIb carcinoma fallback.

full_form: Hepatocellular adenoma -> ICD-O-3.2 8170/0; ICCC-3 Group VII admits behaviour 3 only, so no Group VII code is emitted
notes: A benign tumour, ICD-O-3.2 8170/0. It shares its four digits with hepatocellular carcinoma, but ICCC-3 Group VII admits behaviour 3 only, so no Group VII code is emitted.
coding_note: Behaviour exclusion on the 8170 stem.

full_form: Bile duct adenoma -> ICD-O-3.2 8160/0; ICCC-3 Group VII admits behaviour 3 only, so no Group VII code is emitted
notes: A benign tumour, ICD-O-3.2 8160/0. It shares its four digits with cholangiocarcinoma, but ICCC-3 Group VII admits behaviour 3 only, so no Group VII code is emitted.
coding_note: Behaviour exclusion on the 8160 stem.

full_form: Biliary intraepithelial neoplasia, high grade -> ICD-O-3.2 8148/2; ICCC-3 Group VII admits behaviour 3 only, so no Group VII code is emitted
notes: An in situ lesion, ICD-O-3.2 8148/2, with no behaviour-3 code. ICCC-3 Group VII admits behaviour 3 only, so no Group VII code is emitted.
coding_note: Behaviour exclusion, contract §2A.

full_form: Mesenchymal hamartoma of the liver -> not a reportable malignancy
notes: The second most common benign liver tumour of childhood, usually in the first two years; alpha-fetoprotein can be moderately raised (López-Terrada 2025, p. 39). Not a reportable malignancy. Undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma can arise from it.
coding_note: Benign, no ICD-O-3.2 malignant code; non-reportable terminal.

full_form: Infantile hepatic haemangioma -> not a reportable malignancy
notes: The most common vascular liver tumour of childhood, benign (López-Terrada 2025, p. 33). Not a reportable malignancy. Alpha-fetoprotein is raised in about 14% of haemangiomas, so a raised value does not make a liver mass a hepatoblastoma.
coding_note: Benign vascular tumour; non-reportable terminal.

full_form: Focal nodular hyperplasia -> not a reportable malignancy
notes: A benign liver lesion. Not a reportable malignancy.
coding_note: Benign; non-reportable terminal.

alias: Embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the biliary tree
full_form: Embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma of the biliary tree -> ICCC-3 Group IX
also_known_as: Botryoid rhabdomyosarcoma of the bile duct
notes: The commonest malignant cause of obstructive jaundice in childhood, median age 3 (López-Terrada 2025, p. 38). A soft tissue sarcoma: ICCC-3 Group IX, not Group VII.
coding_note: Refer terminal to Group IX at hp_histology; 8910/3 is IXa at any site (ICCC-2017 row 90).

full_form: Hepatic angiosarcoma -> ICCC-3 Group IX
notes: A vascular sarcoma: ICCC-3 Group IX, not Group VII.
coding_note: Refer terminal to Group IX; 9120/3 is IXd8 at any site (ICCC-2017 row 108).

full_form: Epithelioid haemangioendothelioma of the liver -> ICCC-3 Group IX
notes: A malignant vascular tumour: ICCC-3 Group IX, not Group VII.
coding_note: Refer terminal to Group IX; 9133/3 is IXd8 at any site (ICCC-2017 row 108).

alias: Yolk sac tumour of the liver
full_form: Yolk sac tumour of the liver -> ICCC-3 Group X
notes: A germ cell tumour outside the gonads: ICCC-3 Group X, subgroup Xb, not Group VII. Alpha-fetoprotein is raised in over 90% of yolk sac tumours.
coding_note: Refer terminal to Group X; 9071/3 at C22 is Xb4 (ICCC-2017 row 126).
